name: Protecting models from sneaky attacks hidden in data
gist: These papers study how attackers can poison training data with hidden malicious patterns (backdoors) that make models secretly misbehave, and how to defend against such attacks.
explain: You want to train a model on data from the internet. But what if someone has poisoned that data? They could add mislabeled examples, or add images with hidden patterns (backdoors) that cause the model to misbehave on certain inputs. For example, an attacker could add training images where all pictures with a particular sticker in the corner are mislabeled as 'safe,' so that when the deployed model sees that sticker, it makes a wrong prediction. Or an attacker could inject text data with hidden trigger phrases that cause a language model to follow malicious instructions. The model works normally for everyone else, but anyone who knows the trigger can exploit it. This is data poisoning, and it's particularly dangerous because the attacker doesn't need access to the deployed model—they just need to influence the training data.

Why is this hard? Because training data is often sourced from the internet or crowdsourced from humans, and you can't fully audit every example. If an attacker can inject even a small number of poisoned examples among millions of clean ones, it can work. The backdoor can be subtle: a pattern that the model learns but that a human annotator wouldn't notice. And unlike adversarial examples that affect a single prediction, a backdoor generalizes: once the model learns the trigger, it will respond the same way to similar triggers. Detecting poisoned data requires knowing what to look for, but the attacker can make the trigger so subtle that it's hard to spot. And even if you know some data is poisoned, removing it might require retraining from scratch.

The papers in this area develop two defenses. The first is detection: can you audit training data to find and remove poisoned examples? This includes techniques for identifying mislabeled data, spotting unusual patterns, and testing whether suspected triggers cause misbehavior. The second is resilience: how do you train a model so that poisoned data has minimal effect? This includes techniques that work well even with mislabeling, that learn representations insensitive to backdoor triggers, or that use certified defenses to guarantee that a small number of poisoned examples won't corrupt the model. Some papers study the attack side too, exploring how potent backdoors can be and what makes them hard to detect, which helps defenders understand the threat and prepare defenses in advance by knowing what to look for.

papers.title: CompMarkGS: Robust Watermarking for Compressed 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.contribution: Preserves watermark integrity and rendering quality under compression while maintaining high visual fidelity through HSV loss to mitigate color artifacts.

papers.title: Defending against Backdoor Attacks via Module Switching
papers.contribution: Achieves stronger defense with fewer models in practical settings and superior robustness under collusive attacks where models share backdoors.

papers.title: LLM Fingerprinting via Semantically Conditioned Watermarks
papers.contribution: Fingerprint is both stealthy and robust to all common deployment scenarios including finetuning and quantization.

papers.title: SIGMark: Scalable In-Generation Watermark with Blind Extraction for Video Diffusion
papers.contribution: SIGMark achieves scalable in-generation watermarking with blind extraction and maintains high bit-accuracy under temporal disturbance in modern video diffusion models.

papers.title: STEDiff: Revealing the Spatial and Temporal Redundancy of Backdoor Attacks in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
papers.contribution: STEBA achieves up to 15.07x speedup and 82% GPU memory reduction, while STEDF achieves 99.8% backdoor detection rate using spatio-temporal features.

papers.title: SkillTrojan: Backdoor Attacks on Skill-Based Agent Systems
papers.contribution: Achieves 97.2% attack success rate while maintaining 89.3% clean accuracy on EHR SQL, exposing critical blind spot in skill-based agent architectures.

papers.title: TCAP: Tri-Component Attention Profiling for Unsupervised Backdoor Detection in MLLM Fine-Tuning
papers.contribution: Achieves consistently strong unsupervised backdoor detection performance across diverse MLLM architectures and attack methods.

papers.title: THE SELF-RE-WATERMARKING TRAP: FROM EXPLOIT TO RESILIENCE
papers.contribution: Provide theoretical bounds on message recoverability under malicious re-embedding and demonstrate defense effectiveness.

papers.title: Unmasking Backdoors: An Explainable Defense via Gradient-Attention Anomaly Scoring for Pre-trained Language Models
papers.contribution: Significantly reduces attack success rates compared to baselines; provides interpretability-driven analysis of scoring mechanism for trigger localization and defense robustness.

papers.title: Watermark-based Attribution of AI-Generated Content
papers.contribution: Demonstrate watermark-based attribution remains accurate for unmodified or common post-processed content and resistant to limited-query adversarial post-processing.

papers.title: Why Do Unlearnable Examples Work: A Novel Perspective of Mutual Information
papers.contribution: MI-UE significantly outperforms previous state-of-the-art methods in preventing unauthorized model learning even under defense mechanisms.

papers.title: AliMark: Enhancing Robustness of Sentence-Level Watermarking Against Text Paraphrasing
papers.contribution: AliMark substantially outperforms state-of-the-art baselines under diverse paraphrasing attacks including DIPPER and GPT-3.5.

papers.title: Angel or Demon: Investigating the Plasticity Interventions' Impact on Backdoor Threats in Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Finds SAM exacerbates backdoor threats while other interventions mitigate them; derives novel backdoor detection indicator via loss landscape analysis.

papers.title: Attack-Resistant Watermarking for AIGC Image Forensics via Diffusion-based Semantic Deflection
papers.contribution: PAI achieves 98.43% verification accuracy, improving over state-of-the-art by 37.25% on average, with strong tampering localization against advanced AIGC edits.

papers.title: Attention Hijacking: Backdooring Text Dataset Distillation via Semantic Anchors
papers.contribution: Achieves over 99% attack success rates with clean accuracy preservation, demonstrating stealthy backdoor attacks via attention manipulation.

papers.title: BYORn: Bootstrap Your Own Responses to Defend Large Vision-Language Models Against Backdoor Attacks
papers.contribution: Consistently improves robustness to backdoor attacks while preserving clean-task performance, remaining effective against adaptive attacks designed to circumvent the defense.

papers.title: Beware Untrusted Simulators -- Reward-Free Backdoor Attacks in Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: First demonstration of RL backdoor attacks that transfer to real robotic hardware, highlighting simulator vulnerabilities in the RL pipeline.

papers.title: Block-wise Codeword Embedding for Reliable Multi-bit Text Watermarking
papers.contribution: Achieves TPR of 0.965 with FPR of 0.02 under 10% synonym substitution, solving the high-FPR issue as a solvable structural flaw rather than inherent trade-off.

papers.title: CBV: Clean-label Backdoor Attacks on Vision Language Models via Diffusion Models
papers.contribution: Achieves over 80% attack success rate while preserving normal functionality and maintaining stealthiness against both perplexity-based and guard-model defenses.

papers.title: Catch-22: On the Fundamental Tradeoff Between Detectability and Robustness in LLM Watermarking
papers.contribution: Established bounds on the trilemma among robustness, stealth, and reliable verification, with experimental validation on paraphrasing attacks.

papers.title: Cert-LAS: Toward Certified Model Ownership Verification for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Layer-Adaptive Smoothing
papers.contribution: Proves Cert-LAS achieves reliable verification even under malicious removal attacks.

papers.title: CodeGenGuard: A Robust Watermark for Code Generation Models
papers.contribution: CodeGenGuard achieves superior watermarking performance for code LMs, robust to both benign transformations and adversarial removal attacks.

papers.title: Collaborative Threshold Watermarking
papers.contribution: Remains detectable at scale (K=128) with minimal accuracy loss and robust to attacks including adaptive fine-tuning with 20% training data.

papers.title: DF-LoGiT: Data-Free Logic-Gated Backdoor Attacks in Vision Transformers
papers.contribution: Achieve near-100% attack success with negligible benign accuracy degradation, showing robustness against classical and ViT-specific defenses.

papers.title: Data Provenance Auditing of Fine-Tuned Large Language Models with a Text-Preserving Technique
papers.contribution: Achieves 96.7% true positive rate at 0% false positive rate with only 40 marked documents.

papers.title: Distilling the Thought, Watermarking the Answer: A Principle Semantic Guided Watermark for Reasoning Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Reduces text perplexity by 0.35, increases BLEU score by 0.164, raises mathematical accuracy by 0.67 points, and achieves 0.34% higher watermark detection AUC with negligible latency increase.

papers.title: Dual-branch Robust Unlearnable Examples
papers.contribution: Robustness outperforms 12 SOTA unlearnable example schemes under 7 mainstream defenses, yielding lower average test accuracy of 14.95% to 50.82%.

papers.title: Eyes-on-Me: Scalable RAG Poisoning through Transferable Attention-Steering Attractors
papers.contribution: Raises average attack success from 21.9% to 57.8% (+35.9 points, 2.6x over prior work) with single optimized attractor transferring to unseen black-box systems.

papers.title: Fox in the Henhouse: Supply-Chain Backdoor Attacks Against Reinforcement Learning
papers.contribution: Demonstrates over 90% peak attack success rate and reduces victim returns by 80% with only 3% data corruption, exposing critical vulnerabilities in the RL supply chain.

papers.title: From Poisoned to Aware: Fostering Backdoor Self-Awareness in LLMs
papers.contribution: Demonstrates strong potential to improve LLM robustness against backdoor risks across five backdoor attacks compared to six baseline methods.

papers.title: Guidance Watermarking for Diffusion Models
papers.contribution: Converts any post-hoc watermarking scheme into watermark-embedding approach; preserves generation quality and diversity across diffusion models.

papers.title: Hidden in Plain Tokens: Simply Robust, Gradient-Free Watermark for Synthetic Audio
papers.contribution: Boosts detectability by several orders of magnitude while achieving built-in robustness to audio modifications.

papers.title: How Good is Post-Hoc Watermarking With Language Model Rephrasing?
papers.contribution: Gumbel-max surprisingly outperforms recent alternatives under nucleus sampling with strong detectability on open-ended text, though most approaches struggle with verifiable text like code.

papers.title: INDEXGUARD: Index-only Backdoor Vetting for Secure Federated PEFT of Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Provides end-to-end backdoor mitigation preserving clean accuracy while achieving performance comparable to centralized methods.

papers.title: Ideal Attribution and Faithful Watermarks for Language Models
papers.contribution: Provides unified language for reasoning about watermarking guarantees and clarifies which properties are attainable for practical schemes.

papers.title: In-Context Watermarks for Large Language Models
papers.contribution: ICW demonstrates feasibility as a model-agnostic, practical watermarking approach, and findings suggest it becomes more viable as LLMs improve.

papers.title: LLM Watermark Evasion via Bias Inversion
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art evasion rates over 99% across diverse watermarking schemes while preserving semantic fidelity substantially better than prior baselines.

papers.title: LORD-GoF: A Robust Online Detection Approach for LLM Watermarks in Sparse and Mixed Streams
papers.contribution: Maintains statistical power comparable to offline benchmarks while controlling oFDR under complex mixed streaming scenarios.

papers.title: Learning to Watermark in the Latent Space of Generative Models
papers.contribution: Achieves competitive robustness with up to 20× speedup compared to pixel-space baselines.

papers.title: MOLM: Mixture of LoRA Markers
papers.contribution: MOLM achieves robust key recovery against distortions, compression, regeneration, averaging attacks, and black-box adversarial attacks on Stable Diffusion and FLUX while preserving image quality.

papers.title: MUSE: Model-Agnostic Tabular Watermarking via Multi-Sample Selection
papers.contribution: MUSE reduces distortion rates by 84-88% for fidelity metrics compared to baselines while achieving 1.0 TPR@0.1%FPR detection rate, and is model-agnostic and flexible.

papers.title: Mechanistic Anomaly Detection via Functional Attribution
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art backdoor detection with Defense Effectiveness Rating of 0.93 on BackdoorBench and detects multiple anomaly types across vision and language modalities.

papers.title: Neural Honeytrace: Plug&Play Watermarking Framework against Model Extraction Attacks
papers.contribution: Reduces queries for worst-case ownership verification to 2% of existing methods with zero training cost.

papers.title: NoisePrints: Distortion-Free Watermarks for Authorship in Private Diffusion Models
papers.contribution: NoisePrints provides lightweight, efficient verification using only seed and output without requiring model weight access or computational overhead.

papers.title: PASA: A Principled Embedding-Space Watermarking Approach for LLM-Generated Text under Semantic-Invariant Attacks
papers.contribution: Remains robust under strong paraphrasing attacks while preserving text quality, outperforming vocabulary-space baselines across multiple LLMs and demonstrating fundamental trade-offs among detection accuracy, robustness, and distortion.

papers.title: PMark: Towards Robust and Distortion-free Semantic-level Watermarking with Channel Constraints
papers.contribution: PMark achieves distortion-free property and improves robustness against paraphrasing attacks; outperforms SWM baselines in text quality and robustness for detecting machine-generated text.

papers.title: PolicyGuard: Towards Test-time and Step-level Adversary Defense for Reinforcement Learning Agent
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art detection with average AUROC of 0.856 for perturbation attacks and 0.859 for adversary-agent attacks across seven RL games.

papers.title: RLCracker: Evaluating the Worst-Case Vulnerability of LLM Watermarks with Adaptive RL Attacks
papers.contribution: 98.5% removal success on Unigram-marked texts after training on 100 samples; generalizes across 5 model sizes and 10 schemes.

papers.title: Reliable Poisoned Sample Detection against Backdoor Attacks Enhanced by Sharpness Aware Minimization
papers.contribution: SAM-enhanced PSD achieves average TPR gain of +34.3% over conventional methods under both strong and weak attacks.

papers.title: Rethinking Forgery Attacks on Semantic Watermarks in Black-Box Settings: A Geometric Distortion Perspective
papers.contribution: Propose scheme-agnostic detection distinguishing forged samples before verification; demonstrate effectiveness across diverse black-box scenarios while preserving robustness to common distortions.

papers.title: Rotation-Invariant Spherical Watermarking via Third-Order SO(3) Representation Coupling
papers.contribution: Spherical invariant bispectrum preserves phase information while remaining strictly rotation-invariant, enabling reliable watermark extraction under arbitrary 3D rotations with near-perfect robustness and high visual fidelity.

papers.title: SABRE-FL: Selective and Accurate Backdoor Rejection for Federated Prompt Learning
papers.contribution: SABRE-FL significantly reduces backdoor accuracy while preserving clean accuracy across five datasets and outperforms four baseline defenses.

papers.title: Safeguarding Multimodal Knowledge Copyright in the RAG-as-a-Service Environment
papers.contribution: AQUA enables robust, stealthy, and reliable copyright tracing for image knowledge in multimodal RAG systems.

papers.title: Selective Disclosure Watermarking for Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Enables selective disclosure with fine-grained access control while preserving text quality unbiasedness and achieving high detection accuracy with low latency.

papers.title: SemBind: Binding Diffusion Watermarks to Semantics Against Black-Box Forgery Attacks
papers.contribution: Substantially reduces false acceptance under black-box forgery while preserving image quality across four mainstream watermarking methods with tunable robustness-security trade-offs.

papers.title: Spherical Watermark: Encryption-Free, Lossless Watermarking for Diffusion Models
papers.contribution: Preserves Gaussian priors up to third-order moments, maintains high visual fidelity while improving traceability, computational efficiency, and robustness against attacks.

papers.title: Statistically Undetectable Backdoors in Deep Neural Networks
papers.contribution: Shows fundamental power asymmetry between model trainers and users: backdoors exist but are provably hard to discover or replicate without them.

papers.title: Test-Time Poisoned Sample Detection by Exploiting Shallow Malicious Matching in Backdoored CLIP
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms existing detection methods against backdoored CLIP by identifying shallow malicious matching in poisoned images.

papers.title: TimeGuard: Channel-wise Pool Training for Backdoor Defense in Time Series Forecasting
papers.contribution: Improves robustness by 1.96x in MAE_P over leading baseline while preserving clean performance within 5% MAE_C across multiple datasets and TSF architectures.

papers.title: Towards Reliable Marking and Verification of AI-Generated Text via Geometry-aware Sentence-level Watermarking
papers.contribution: Consistently improves robustness while preserving text fluency across multiple models and languages with practical black-box deployability.

papers.title: Traceable Black-Box Watermarks For Federated Learning
papers.contribution: TraMark ensures traceability of all watermarked models while preserving main task performance across various FL systems.

papers.title: TrojanTO: Action-Level Backdoor Attacks Against Trajectory Optimization Models
papers.contribution: TrojanTO effectively implants backdoors across diverse tasks and TO architectures (DT, GDT, DC) with low attack budget (0.3% of trajectories).

papers.title: Uncovering Hidden Triggers: Backdoor Attribution in Language Models
papers.contribution: Ablating ~3% of attention heads reduces Attack Success Rate by >90%, and a single vector intervention can boost ASR to ~100% or suppress to ~0%.

papers.title: WMVLM: Evaluating Diffusion Model Image Watermarking via Vision-Language Models
papers.contribution: Outperforms state-of-the-art VLMs with strong generalization across datasets, diffusion models, and watermarking methods while providing interpretability.

papers.title: WaterDrum: Watermark-based Data-centric Unlearning Metric
papers.contribution: Provides first data-centric unlearning metric for LLMs with benchmark datasets for rigorous evaluation.

papers.title: Watermarking Graph Neural Networks via Explanations for Ownership Protection
papers.contribution: Theoretically proves locating the watermark is NP-hard; demonstrates robustness to fine-tuning and pruning attacks while eliminating data dependencies.

papers.title: Watermarking LLM Agent Trajectories
papers.contribution: Achieves average detection AUC of 94.3 on Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B with negligible performance degradation.

papers.title: dgMARK: Decoding-Guided Watermarking for Diffusion Language Models
papers.contribution: A plug-and-play watermarking method robust to post-editing operations (insertion, deletion, substitution, paraphrasing) via decoding-guided order selection.
